verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents integrating browser automation through Python, TypeScript and REST [skyvern-docs-1], and its core task and automation features are reachable from the API and SDK. These include prompt-driven tasks, structured extraction, persistent sessions and an MCP server [skyvern-docs-17][skyvern-docs-18][skyvern-docs-4][skyvern-docs-5][skyvern-docs-21][skyvern-docs-7]. However, several UI-centric features are only described as dashboard or Cloud UI capabilities with no API equivalent evidenced: the drag-and-drop workflow builder, browser recorder, SOP upload, copilot chat and template sharing [skyvern-docs-3][skyvern-docs-6][skyvern-docs-22][skyvern-docs-23][skyvern-docs-24][skyvern-docs-25]. Probes also found no public OpenAPI spec at the checked paths [skyvern-probe-3]. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity documentation, API coverage for workflow building/recorder/SOP/copilot/template sharing, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of API completeness.
